text:
mira: follow-up from the continuous-batcher RFC thread: production and load-tests reveal a short enqueue->serve tail when tenants are evicted then immediately burst. want to pick a low-risk mitigation to prototype.

hao: can you paste the smallest trace we have?

mira: sure. synthetic trace snippet (very small):
```
trace=tx-ff01
0ms enqueue
60000ms soft_lease_expire
60020ms burst_enqueue
60180ms allocate_done
60200ms serve_start
```

lucy: that ~160-200ms allocation gap is visible in p50 and p95. Two candidate fixes: (A) keep a tiny post-expiry reserve (micro-tail) for G ms, or (B) allocator-side transient loans (short-lived tokens on first enqueue).

hao: micro-tail is straightforward conceptually but requires changing lease state machine. Transient loans are allocator-local, simpler to ship, but add a short accounting surface.

mira: here's a hybrid-ish twist: transient loan only for the first enqueue after eviction and only if tenant's recent median qps < threshold. Limits blast misuse.

lucy: good. proposed safety knobs: global transient pool <= 3% of pool tokens, per-tenant max = 25 tokens, loan ttl = 150ms, per-tenant cooldown initial = 250ms with exponential backoff, eligibility requires recent_median_qps < 5.

hao: metrics to add: enqueue_to_serve_ms_histogram{cohort,tenant}, transient_loans_granted_total, transient_loan_reclaims_total, evicted_rehydrate_count, pool_transient_util_pct. example query: avg_over_time(histogram_quantile(0.95, enqueue_to_serve_ms_bucket{service="continuous-batcher"})[30m]) by (cohort)

mira: experiment plan: A/B 1:1 across 100 internal tenants for 24h on staging-like pool. Turn transient loans ON for group A. Success criteria: 95p enqueue->serve reduced by >=30% and token-cost delta <=1.0%. Rollback if transient usage growth >12%/hr or cost delta >1.5%.

lucy: implementation note: allocator currently has allocate(tenant, tokens, mode). We'll add mode="transient_loan" which maps to borrow_transient(tenant, tokens, ttl_ms) and returns a temporary lease id. Loans are visible in short-term telemetry but excluded from autoscaler triggers and long-term billing.

hao: failure mode: noisy tenant could cycle loans and cause oscillation. Mitigations: require eligibility gate (recent_median_qps < threshold), per-tenant cooldown, global cap, telemetry alarm if loan_retries/sec spikes.

mira: owners: I'll implement experiment infra and dashboard wiring, Hao owns allocator changes, Lucy will own metrics PR and alert rules, ops-bot will schedule canary once PRs land.

ops-bot: canary deploy scheduled: batcher/transient-loan-probe -> canary-3 at 2024-05-06T10:00:00Z :rocket:

mira: thanks. I'll post the dashboard link once metrics are in. If anyone prefers we invest in the micro-tail lease-state change first, say now; otherwise we'll iterate on transient loans. :eyes:
